## ASML Valuation Debated as AI Demand Drives Guidance Higher

ASML is the gating constraint on leading-edge chip capacity; a valuation debate against AI-lifted guidance is a proxy for how much of the AI capex cycle the market has already discounted — directly relevant to sizing the AI infrastructure thesis across the supply chain.

- Coverage questions whether ASML's current valuation is justifiable given AI-driven guidance improvements.
- AI demand is cited as the operative catalyst lifting ASML's forward outlook.
- The framing is a valuation-vs-growth debate, not a negative fundamental read.
- ASML's position as the sole EUV lithography supplier directly links its outlook to the AI infrastructure capex cycle.
